player_outcomes: Mara Tallow begins at Flood Control Dam #3 as an independent field surveyor rather than appearing as museum furniture
TALK TO MARA establishes her Last Honest Survey goal and ASK MARA ABOUT SURVEY, DAM, COMPANY, HOUSE, MUSEUM, and witnessed evidence remains knowledge-limited
MARA, FOLLOW ME and MARA, WAIT move or retain one physical actor through authored Dam and earned House routes without teleporting her
MARA, BRACE PANEL plus the canonical yellow interlock, wrench, and bolt creates a jointly witnessed gate cycle without bypassing the original puzzle
SURVEY DAM WITH MARA creates one physical joint survey sheet in Mara's custody and establishes a functional alliance
Mara warns against the blue pipe circuit, refuses an order to trigger it, retreats if the player ignores her, and remembers repair and a specific apology
Mara witnesses the real silverfin only when present and distinguishes capture from live release
Mara owns a physical pack, notebook, rope, lantern, and survey sheet; companionship does not grant automatic custody
KISS MARA cannot force intimacy and receives a history-aware boundary rather than a romance reward
boundaries: no generic follower framework, party system, pathfinding simulator, chatbot, dialogue tree, approval meter, inventory mule, hint engine, or romance economy
no replacement of canonical Dam controls, solo puzzle solvability, troll combat, museum custody, fishing specimen identity, or House systems
no omniscient Mara knowledge, remote observation, duplicated evidence, free second puzzle light, automatic ownership, or teleported reunion
no debug verbs, test-only production actors, audit-of-audit machinery, recursive qualification framework, or S.T.A.L.K.E.R. coupling
